Leaf & Lineage — Simplified v1.0

Frozen from release 20261021-10, commit 81346603e146ecc6dc2c7fe4638cfe754d86a4f9.

Open index.html through a web server, or open Leaf-and-Lineage-Simplified.html as a self-contained offline game.
Teacher setup: append ?teacher=1 to the hosted folder URL.
Classroom links generated here stay under /simplified/. Older LL1–LL4 starting codes remain supported.

All original game behavior is preserved. The edition name is the only interface change.
The detailed Pattern Lab is planned separately.
